situations.headline: Cygnus Metals scheme with CAML clears shareholder vote condition

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Cygnus Metals scheme with CAML clears shareholder vote condition (interest 5, risk 3)

thesis.text: Cygnus is in the late stages of a scheme of arrangement whereby CAML will acquire 100% of its shares, with the CAML-side shareholder approval now obtained; remaining risk is deal completion risk (other Scheme Implementation Deed conditions, independent expert opinion, court approval) rather than standalone operating risk, making this a binary merger-arb situation pending disclosure of final terms/timeline [asx:1ae062700bb8a877683cef6b042c63f8 p.1-2].
